title: Restricted Fourier estimator output
statement: Let $f:\{-1,1\}^{n}\to\{\pm1\}$ be a Boolean function, let $J\subseteq\mathrm{Fin}(n)$ and $S\subseteq J$ be finite, and let $m\in\mathbb{N}$. Given three $m$-tuples of Boolean inputs $z,y,y'$, the output is the empirical restricted Fourier weight of the observation batch formed from $f,J,S$ and those inputs.
caveat: The supplied statement does not include the definitions of the observation batch or empirical restricted Fourier weight.
